Kinetic sand is a great way to provide sensory input while still working on a multitude of skills.  I love to use cookie cutters in the sand to work on bilateral skills, pressure and and force regulation.  Cutting with sand is a great introduction to snipping and provides additional sensory feedback. Kids who are struggling with writing tend to be more willing to practice writing on different surfaces. Try sand and use a paint brush for smooth lines.  #occupationaltherapy #ot #sensoryactivities #finemotorskills #sensory #schoolbasedot

Kinetic Sand Cutting Amazing And It's So Satisfying! What you are seeing is pure ASMR kinetic sand cutting with a long green blade. The sand starts as a perfect round dome, soft but holds shape like wet beach sand. First cut removes half, then the artist slices it into a perfect triangle with straight edges. Each slice is clean because kinetic sand is 98% sand mixed with 2% silicone polymer that makes it stick. Then he carves deep grooves parallel to each side, creating a layered pyramid staircase. He flips the angle and cuts again, forming a perfect diamond grid pattern that looks like architecture. Every cut makes that soft crunch sound, the sand never crumbles, it just peels off smoothly. This is how artists turn simple kinetic sand into insane geometric art that satisfies your brain. #KineticSand #SatisfyingCutting #ASMR
